decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable that fits the firm's thermoforming range, and having its own page signals active marketing.
PETG thermoforming blanks are a core material in dental thermoforming and drive recurring sales alongside the firm's machines.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website, but it complements the firm's earmold and dental lab workflows and costs little to keep in the catalog.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the growing intraoral scanning market and has its own page, so it is worth keeping.
Custom earmolds fit the firm's otoplastic business, and a product line like this is rarely withdrawn after one year.
Custom hearing protection serves a steady occupational safety demand and uses the same production as the other earmolds.
